column_description: TEXT. Identifier linking regulatory-compliance data to a market-condition set. PK. FK to market_conditions(REC_PIN).
TEXT. Filing-status state. Possible values: Current, Delayed, Missing.
TEXT. Disclosure-status state. Possible values: Full, Non-compliant, Partial.
TEXT. Trading-restriction window status. **NULL means restriction window not defined.**. Possible values: Blackout, Special.
TEXT. Flag indicating broker-dealer involvement. **NULL means broker-flag unset.**. Possible values: Complete, Incomplete, Late.
TEXT. Exchange note or comment. **NULL means no exchange note present.**. Possible values: Inquiry, Warning.
TEXT. Current investment-status designation. **NULL means investment status not specified.**. Possible values: Active, Preliminary.
TEXT. Alert-level assigned by compliance monitoring. Possible values: Critical, High, Low, Medium.
TEXT. Investigation-priority indicator. Possible values: High, Low, Medium.
TEXT. Flag indicating an open compliance case. Possible values: Closed, Investigation, Monitoring.
TEXT. Recommended frequency of compliance reviews. **NULL means review frequency not defined.**. Possible values: Daily, Monthly, Weekly.
DATE. Date of the most recent compliance review. Example: 2025/02/02.
DATE. Scheduled date of the next compliance review. Example: March 19, 2025.
TEXT. Monitoring-intensity setting. Possible values: Enhanced, Intensive, Standard.
TEXT. Surveillance system used. Possible values: Multiple, Primary, Secondary.
TEXT. Detection method applied. Possible values: Automated, Hybrid, Manual.
REAL. False-positive rate of the detection system. Example: 0.033.
REAL. Confidence score of the detection model. Example: 0.883.
REAL. Pattern-recognition metric for compliance. Example: 42.51.
REAL. Behavioural risk score from compliance analytics. Example: 37.76.
REAL. Network-based compliance risk score. Example: 68.91.
TEXT. The concentration of regulatory alerts per billion USD of trading volume. Helps identify market manipulation risks. Example: 45.2 alerts/billion USD.
TEXT. The speed of regulatory response, measured in hours per case. A lower value indicates faster response times. Example: 42.3 hours/case.

JSONB column. Regulatory compliance data including violations and risk.
Fields: {"comp_rate":"TEXT. Compliance rate category. Possible values: A, B, C, D.","prev_viol":"BIGINT. Count of previous regulatory violations. Possible values: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.","risk_val":"REAL. Quantitative risk value for compliance breaches. Example: 58.84."}
